name: Vote option
description: How a member's vote is recorded. Being absent is kept separate from abstaining, because they mean different things. Abstaining is a choice; being absent isn't. Some systems count them differently toward a required majority.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Yes
hasDefinedTerm.description: In favor. Aye, for, ja, oui.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Abstain
hasDefinedTerm.description: Present, but chose not to vote.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Excused
hasDefinedTerm.description: Absent with the body's permission, often because of a conflict of interest.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Not voting
hasDefinedTerm.description: Present, but recorded as not voting — where the system tracks this separately from abstaining.
